items.reason: The resort's first visitors are the opening of the Layang-Layang resort whose completion is 1989's ev-50de0edf83 (MY-1980s undecided, prev file); same practice at the same level. Provisional on 1989 being decided.

A description of standing patrols, garrisons and air reconnaissance at the three reefs; 1989's record (prev file: ev-50de0edf83, ev-c268da3204) has no patrol candidate, though 1988's ev-5df85f5fed (MY-1980s) described the same practice. Likely a continuation of an undocumented practice (reject); settled by a 1989 patrol source.

Novelty: building a 1,067 m runway on Swallow Reef adds air access, a new method against 1990's record (resort opening ev-966de97b8a, patrols ev-adbe75b4ab); lead of the 1991 airstrip move. The sources differ on whether December 1991 was the decision or the extension.
The $18 million 1992 allocation for Pulau Layang-Layang, debated amid neighbours' protests at the airstrip plan, funds the airstrip move ev-f0b2e35258.
Najib's statement that the airstrip will go ahead despite objections is the verbal side of the airstrip move ev-f0b2e35258.

Novelty: officially renaming Terumbu Layang-Layang as Pulau Layang-Layang, recasting a reef as an island, is an administrative status change with nothing comparable in 1991's record (airstrip group ev-f0b2e35258).

Novelty: a formal rejection aimed at China's 1992 territorial-sea law, with a conditional pledge to take steps to defend sovereignty; 1991's verbal record (ev-d61240caad) only brushed off protests over the airstrip. Lead of the 1992 rejection move.

The July written answers repeat the 1992 rejection of all rival claims led by ev-5308c6f3a6 and add an intent to develop Mariveles and Ardasier; same declarative move, with the intent to be watched for the year it is carried out.

Novelty: the first visit by the head of state to Layang-Layang, a symbolic display of sovereignty absent from 1991's record (ev-f0b2e35258 group); the last leader's visit was Mahathir's in 1984. A coder may join it with the renaming ev-5e3a768fdc as one Layang-Layang upgrade.

A national EEZ-enforcement summary (384 intrusions, detentions and fines) with no breakdown by nationality or area, mostly Thai boats probably in undisputed waters. Settled by a breakdown showing detentions of claimants' boats in the disputed Spratly area; 1991's record has no enforcement candidate.

RM60.4 million spent developing Layang-Layang for presence and tourism continues the development 1992's ev-d9859516e1 said would go on, with no new method named. Provisional; the CSM's 1993 dating of the resort opening should be checked against ev-966de97b8a.

The same national fisheries-arrest practice as 1992's ev-2b3578f9ed at a lower level (606 fishermen/85 vessels to July 1993 against 680/96 in 1992), with no area breakdown. Not an intensification, and possibly not in disputed waters.
Novelty: legally declaring Station Mike on Mariveles Reef a protected zone is a new jurisdictional designation; 1993's record (spending ev-edd8bdf590, arrests ev-d7595bdd7f) has nothing comparable.
The same national fisheries-arrest practice as 1993's ev-d7595bdd7f (74 cases to June 1994, 19 of them Vietnamese) with no locations; no change of method. Same caveat: possibly undisputed waters.

A restatement defining the claim as lying outside the Spratlys proper, under UNCLOS, with an offer to negotiate; 1993's record has no comparable declarative candidate. Likely a routine restatement (reject) unless the coder reads the reframing of the legal basis as a new position (novelty).

Novelty: naval gunfire at a Chinese fishing boat is a change of method from 1994's arrests (ev-8d7c5c5c73), described as the first violent China-ASEAN incident. Rests on one secondary source with no day or place, so it needs corroboration.

Novelty: Mahathir's overnight visit to Layang-Layang with stepped-up patrols and a large-scale exercise during the Mischief Reef crisis (reactions count); 1994's record has no visit, patrol or exercise. Lead of the 1995 Layang-Layang show-of-presence move.
The minister's 'indisputable' Swallow Reef claim at the end of May is the verbal side of the same May 1995 response led by ev-83f809b7bf.

Novelty: the UNCLOS ratification declarations reject other states' inconsistent maritime claims and require consent for foreign military exercises in the EEZ; 1995's record has no legal instrument. Ratification itself is cooperative, so the call rests on the declarations alone.

An unpublicised Cabinet decision to occupy Investigator Shoal and Erica Reef. The series dates behaviour, not decisions, so it is evidence for the 1999 occupation move ev-bc804621b3 rather than a 1996 move (same treatment as the 1979 and 1981 cabinet orders). Settled if it was made public in 1996.

A new station module commissioned on Ardasier Reef (Station Uniform, garrisoned since 1986). Settled by whether it enlarges the station (then a novelty/scope move against 1995, which has nothing comparable) or replaces the 1986 outpost at the same level (maintenance, likely reject).

A pledge that the Swallow Reef garrison will stay: maintenance of the 1983 occupation. 1997 has no candidates at all, so strictly it is new again, but that looks like a source gap (§K). Likely reject, unless the coder applies new-again to the blank 1997.

Routine naval and air watch over Swallow and nearby reefs, the practice 1990's ev-adbe75b4ab described; 1997 has no candidates to compare. The warships deterred are unidentified (dyad MU, a non-claimant). Likely a continuation of an undocumented practice (reject).

Scope: occupying Investigator Shoal (and Erica Reef, ev-0f1a31059d) extends Malaysia's garrisons to two more features, against 1998's record showing only the existing garrisons maintained (ev-2bcc8f7768, ev-cb3415c14d); lead of the 1999 occupations move.
Station Sierra on Erica Reef is the second occupation of the same April-May 1999 operation led by ev-bc804621b3.
The concrete building and helipad completed by June on the two newly occupied features consolidate the occupation move ev-bc804621b3.
The Dewan Negara defence of the Erica and Investigator presence against the protests is the verbal side of the occupation move ev-bc804621b3.

Novelty: RMAF Hawks driving off Philippine OV-10s over Investigator Shoal is the first Malaysian air interception found, a coercive method absent from 1998's record (ev-cb3415c14d: foreign warships leaving after detection, with no interference).

An RM10 million Layang-Layang development line in the 2000 Budget, reported by a backbencher; 1998's record has no development candidate to continue. Likely a routine allocation (reject); settled by whether it funds a new facility.
